title: Synapse: Optimizing Natural-Language Agent Skills through Program Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.20856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve task performance by optimizing reusable natural-language skills without updating model parameters. Execution feedback reveals failures but does not directly identify which instructions to edit, which related instructions matter, or which tasks an edit may break. We propose Synapse, which casts skill optimization as generate-and-validate repair over a partial program view. A deterministic compiler translates recognized skill constructs into SkIR, a source-linked intermediate representation, while retaining other requirements in the text. Synapse combines execution traces with control-flow and dependence relations to localize faults, propose typed mutations, and select related repair tests, including previously passing ones. translated_title: Synapse：通过程序修复优化自然语言智能体技能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.20856v1 公告类型：新论文。大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以通过优化可复用的自然语言技能来提升任务表现，而无需更新模型参数。执行反馈能够揭示失败，但并不能直接指出需要编辑哪些指令、哪些相关指令是重要的，或者某次编辑可能会破坏哪些任务。我们提出 Synapse，它将技能优化建模为对部分程序视图的“生成-验证”式修复。一个确定性编译器将可识别的技能构造翻译为 SkIR——一种与源文本关联的中间表示，同时将其余需求保留在文本中。Synapse 将执行轨迹与控制流及依赖关系相结合，以定位故障、提出类型化的变异操作，并选择相关的修复测试用例（包括之前通过的测试）。每个变异都会被写回其映射的源文本区间并重新编译；验证过程决定其是否被接受。每个被接受的补丁都能产生格式良好的技能，并保留未受……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Synapse 将自然语言技能优化建模为对部分程序视图的“生成-验证”式程序修复，通过编译器生成中间表示 SkIR，结合执行轨迹与控制流/依赖分析来定位故障、提出类型化变异并用修复测试验证补丁，从而在不更新模型参数的情况下优化 LLM 智能体技能。
en_tdlr: Synapse frames natural-language skill optimization for LLM agents as generate-and-validate program repair over a partial program view, using a compiler-generated intermediate representation (SkIR), execution traces, and control-flow/dependence analysis to localize faults, propose typed mutations, and validate patches without updating model parameters.
